The latest update on the Steam platform will now correctly uninstall EAC. However, we aren't able to automate this process for the Oculus platform currently.
To manually uninstall EAC, you can follow the steps below:
1. Navigate to your VRChat Installation Directory
2. Open the EasyAntiCheat folder
3. Type "CMD" in the File Explorer address bar and then hit Enter
4. Paste "EasyAntiCheat_EOS_Setup.exe uninstall a4a57ff548934dbeba0cc7c62cdf9f34" into the Command Line without including quotation marks
If you've already uninstalled VRChat you can follow the steps here:
1. Go to C:\Program Files (x86) and delete "EasyAntiCheat_EOS"
2. Run Command Prompt as admin and use the command "sc delete EasyAntiCheat_EOS"

details:
VRChat version: 2022.2-8d03df2a56 
Description of the bug:
According to the docs of EAC, the EAC will be removed if I uninstalled the game.
However, after uninstalling VRC, the service EasyAntiCheat_EOS will still be on the services list.
Please uninstall EAC when uninstalling VRChat  Some friend found a document *for developer* and the command in the doc, `EasyAntiCheat_EOS_Setup.exe uninstall <ProductId-in-json>`, is working for me to uninstall EAC.
That's why  I think the mechanism to uninstall EAC is not broken and I think this is a VRChat’s fault.
My environment is Windows11 so I thought that may be because of using unsupported Windows version. 
However, some my friends reported me that same happens on windows 10 so I reported here.
 
Source EAC doc: https://www.easy.ac/en-us/support/game/guides/installer/
Source EAC doc for devs: https://dev.epicgames.com/docs/services/en-US/GameServices/AntiCheat/index.html#configuration
Steps to reproduce:
 1) uninstall VRChat via steam
 2) find service list on some app (e.g. Task Manager)  3) you can find EasyAntiCheat_EOS
